**(a) Social posts**

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must work toward a ban before that future is built.

2. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We say this plainly because the stakes demand honesty—and action.

3. We are working toward a ban on superintelligence because if it is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. The time to act is now.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We face a choice with consequences for every country and every generation. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We believe this plainly and without reservation. That is why the Institute for Long-Term Intelligence Policy works to build public understanding and policy support for a ban on superintelligence. This is not a distant, abstract concern: decisions made now will shape whether these systems are developed and deployed. We must not treat the prospect of catastrophic loss as an acceptable price for technological competition. We can choose a different course, and we must act with urgency to secure it.
